patterns.visual_description: Single hero packshot rises from a glowing central point against a branded gradient background. Product settles into locked center frame with subtle metallic light sweep.
patterns.camera_language: Locked frontal camera, 70mm full-frame equivalent. No camera movement during product lock.
patterns.lighting_language: Large diffused frontal key light. Low-intensity branded fill (magenta/violet for NAN). Subtle rim light defining product edges. Soft volumetric glow at product base.
patterns.motion_language: Vertical rise with smooth ease-in, light deceleration at rest position. Metallic reflections stabilize on lock.
patterns.safe_usage_notes: Preserve packshot geometry exactly. No shape morphing. Label must be legible at all frames. Do not animate the product after it locks into hero position.
patterns.example_prompt_fragment: The NAN COMFOR package rises vertically from a central luminous glow, easing into hero foreground position. Metallic reflections stabilize. Locked frontal camera. 70mm lens. Magenta-purple gradient background.

patterns.visual_description: Multiple packshots emerge sequentially: rear-left and rear-right units rise first, then the hero front-center unit rises with a stronger luminous pulse. Creates depth and hierarchy.
patterns.camera_language: Locked frontal camera. Depth achieved through product scale and position, not camera movement.
patterns.lighting_language: Each package receives branded ambient fill. Hero product gets stronger key light and volumetric pulse on entry.
patterns.motion_language: Sequential vertical rises with staggered timing. Each unit settles before the next begins. Hero unit enters last with strongest motion.
patterns.safe_usage_notes: Maintain brand identity of each SKU individually. Do not allow packages to intersect during motion. Rear packages remain slightly smaller to suggest depth.
patterns.example_prompt_fragment: Rear-left NAN COMFOR package rises and settles. Rear-right mirrors. Front-center hero rises with luminous pulse and settles into foreground. Locked frontal camera. Sequential entrance.

patterns.visual_description: Molecular structures, hexagonal overlays, fine luminous lines, and floating light particles drift across the background. Supporting element — never obscures product.
patterns.camera_language: Locked camera. Particles move in depth layers creating parallax without camera motion.
patterns.lighting_language: Particles are self-luminous, matching brand color (magenta/teal/gold depending on brand). Low opacity to not compete with product.
patterns.motion_language: Slow drift from edges inward, converging near product in final frames. Subtle pulsing glow.
patterns.safe_usage_notes: Particles must NOT obscure packshot label or logo. Keep particle density low in product safe zone (center 60% of frame). Never use particle explosion — use convergence instead.
patterns.example_prompt_fragment: Futuristic interface graphics, circular arcs, molecular nodes, fine luminous lines and floating particles drift inward from lateral edges. Particles remain outside the product safe zone. Low opacity.

patterns.visual_description: Product-relevant liquid (milk, formula, water) splashes in slow motion around or below the packshot. Macro lens captures droplet detail.
patterns.camera_language: Macro push-in or locked close-up. Shallow depth of field — product remains sharp, liquid in soft focus.
patterns.lighting_language: Strong backlight for liquid translucency. Front fill preserving packshot legibility.
patterns.motion_language: Slow-motion splash synchronized with product reveal. Liquid does not obscure front label.
patterns.safe_usage_notes: Liquid must match product identity (e.g., white/cream for formula). Do not splash liquid onto label zone. Confirm liquid type is consistent with actual product.
patterns.example_prompt_fragment: Slow-motion white formula droplets rise and fall around the base of the NAN COMFOR can. Macro lens. Strong backlight. Product label remains sharp and fully legible.

patterns.visual_description: Fine white/gold powder erupts from the product base or lid, disperses softly, and settles. Reveals the product in the clearing cloud.
patterns.camera_language: Slow push-in during burst. Camera settles as powder disperses.
patterns.lighting_language: Backlight to rim-light the powder cloud. Front key restores after dispersal.
patterns.motion_language: Fast burst, then slow dispersal. Product emerge from center of the cloud.
patterns.safe_usage_notes: Do not obscure label during reveal — powder disperses outward. Confirm powder color matches product. Do not suggest powder spill or waste messaging.
patterns.example_prompt_fragment: A soft burst of fine white nutritional powder rises from the product base, disperses outward, and settles to reveal the NAN COMFOR can in full clarity. Backlit. Slow-motion.

patterns.visual_description: A horizontal or diagonal light beam sweeps across the packshot from left to right, creating a premium metallic highlight pass.
patterns.camera_language: Locked camera. Light in motion, not camera.
patterns.lighting_language: Sharp narrow beam. High specular on metallic surfaces. Does not overexpose product label.
patterns.safe_usage_notes: Do not let beam overexpose label typography. Keep label contrast above threshold during sweep.
patterns.example_prompt_fragment: A premium horizontal light sweep moves across the metallic NAN COMFOR can from left to right, creating a sharp specular highlight pass. Locked camera. Single sweep.

patterns.visual_description: Camera slowly dollies forward toward the product. Background blurs softly as product sharpens.
patterns.camera_language: Slow dolly-in, 70mm equivalent. Bokeh background increases during push.
patterns.lighting_language: Cinematic key-fill setup. Product stays lit throughout the dolly.
patterns.motion_language: Smooth, unhurried forward motion. 1.5 to 3 second duration.
patterns.safe_usage_notes: Product must remain in focus throughout. Do not dolly so close that packshot bleeds outside frame.
patterns.example_prompt_fragment: Camera slowly dollies forward toward the NAN COMFOR hero packshot. Background gradient blurs softly. Product sharpens. 70mm cinematic lens.

patterns.visual_description: Light rays or particles converge in the lower-right corner to form the #1 or quality seal badge. The badge resolves from light into a solid, readable graphic element.
patterns.camera_language: Locked camera. Badge builds in frame corner.
patterns.lighting_language: Condensed light rays. High contrast on the badge itself for readability.
patterns.motion_language: Convergence of particles, then resolving into solid badge. Duration 1-1.5 seconds.
patterns.safe_usage_notes: Badge must exactly match the approved packshot artwork. Do not invent badge content. Only use if the badge is present in the source packshot.
patterns.example_prompt_fragment: Glowing particles converge in the lower-right corner. Light rays condense into the illuminated number-1 seal, resolving precisely into the exact badge shown in the final frame artwork.
